display_long_description:
Designed for the Mishkat Interactive Center in Riyadh, this VR experience lets you explore how renewable energy works through hands-on play. Step into three interactive mini-games and learn the basics of wind, solar, and hydroelectric power.

What You Will Do
    • Wind Energy: Grab a wind cloud and direct it’s currents toward turbines to generate electricity.
    • Solar Energy: Turn solar panels to align them with the sun, and send out a cleaning bot to sweep away dust for maximum output.
    • Hydroelectric Energy: Take control of a hydroelectric dam by balancing gates to regulate water flow to adjust power supply to demand.

Highlights
    • Direct VR Interactions: Physical controls — poking, grabbing, turning, and pulling—built to be intuitive for young children.
    • Accessible Learning: Understand key renewable energy concepts through active gameplay without complicated jargon.
    • Child-Safe Design: Fully ad-free experience with zero data collection.
